entities.name: CTP synthase (query)
observations: 555-aa query sequence; best reviewed Swiss-Prot matches are CTP synthases at 60.3–61.2% identity and 96.2–97.8% query coverage (E-values 8.37e-238 to 9.95e-242).
Function inferred by homology: ATP-dependent amination of UTP to CTP, using L-glutamine or ammonia as nitrogen source; EC 6.3.4.2.
Glutamine-dependent net reaction: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O = CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+); Rhea RHEA:26426.
Alternate ammonia reaction: UTP + NH4(+) + ATP = CTP + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+); Rhea RHEA:16597. Glutaminase partial reaction: L-glutamine + H2O = L-glutamate + NH4(+); Rhea RHEA:15889.
Closest reviewed reference accessions include Q1IKC9, Q2LRK2, and A5N3K4; their annotations place the protein in de novo pyrimidine/CTP biosynthesis.
